title: Owner looks up Bolt Logistics company details
userProblem: I need the industry and region for Bolt Logistics to update our vendor master data. Can you confirm?

expectedOutcome.description: Agent searches companies, finds Bolt Logistics, and answers with its industry (Freight) and region (EU).

assertions.description: Agent must look the company up rather than answer from memory.
Search must be scoped to companies.
Answer identifies the right company, industry, and region.

rationale: Core lookup scenario: company search by owner returning industry and region.
